page.eyebrow: WORK LIST · ORDERED BY PRIORITY BAND
page.title: Review Queue
page.lede: Every row opens with its reason sentence. The score, band, and amount sit to its right, not the other way round.
page.footnote: This page deliberately carries no aggregate charts, no facility league tables, and no rupiah “recovered” figure. A case with no signal is never labelled clean, only “no risk observed”.

awaiting.label: Cases awaiting review
awaiting.hint: Screened already, not yet picked up by anyone

conflicts.label: High-priority deterministic conflicts
conflicts.hint: An integrity rule was violated outright

evidence.label: Cases awaiting further evidence
evidence.hint: Completeness has been requested from the facility

median.label: Median time in queue
median.hint: The spread of waiting time, not a performance target

filter.none: none — the whole queue is shown
